FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
A practical starting point for planning an Odoo implementation or improvement project.

div.div: Odoo is a suite of connected business applications that can bring areas such as sales, inventory, accounting and people operations into one system.

h3.button: Can Odoo be customized for our business?

div.div: Yes. Standard configuration should be used where it fits, while focused custom modules can support requirements that need different behavior.

h3.button: Can we migrate from our current software?

div.div: Migration is possible after the source data, quality, history requirements and target Odoo structure have been reviewed.

h3.button: Can Odoo integrate with existing systems?

div.div: Odoo supports integrations, but the right approach depends on the other system, its interfaces and which data or actions need to stay synchronized.
Post-launch work typically includes user support, issue resolution, workflow refinement and planned improvements as teams learn from real use.
